# TalentLMS

> TalentLMS is the #1 cloud-based learning management system for organizations to create, manage, and deliver online training courses with AI-powered content generation and comprehensive employee development capabilities.

TalentLMS provides an all-in-one platform for corporate training, employee onboarding, partner enablement, and customer education. The platform features AI-powered course creation through TalentCraft, pre-built soft skills content via TalentLibrary, and skills management for talent development.

## Key Topics

- Learning Management System (LMS)
- AI-Powered Course Creation
- Employee Training & Development
- Employee Onboarding
- Partner Training & Channel Enablement
- Customer Training & Product Adoption
- TalentCraft - AI Course Generator
- TalentLibrary - Soft Skills Courses
- Skills Management & Succession Planning
- Learning Paths
- Compliance Training
- GDPR & WCAG Compliance
- Cloud-Based Platform
- Course Management
- Talent Development
